Variables come in three shapes, each with its own prefix:

- **Scalar** — `${name}` holds one value.
- **List** — `@{name}` holds an ordered sequence.
- **Dictionary** — `&{name}` holds key/value pairs.

Declare them in `*** Variables ***`, or create them inline with **`VAR`**
(Robot Framework 7+) inside a test or keyword. Access a list item with
`${list}[0]` and a dictionary value with `${dict}[key]`.

## Task 1 — Declare scalar, list, and dictionary variables

**Goal:** create `checks/variables.robot` with one scalar, one list, and one
dictionary variable, and a test that reads all three.

Here is the same shape over different data — a city, some days, and a few ages.
Adapt the names and values to the shop.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Variables ***
${CITY}    Helsinki
@{DAYS}    mon    tue    wed
&{AGES}    ada=31    grace=45

*** Test Cases ***
Values Are Set
    Should Be Equal    ${CITY}    Helsinki
    Length Should Be    ${DAYS}    3
    Should Be Equal    ${AGES}[ada]    31
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `checks/variables.robot` defines `${SHOP}`, `@{PRODUCTS}`, and
`&{PRICES}`, and the assertions pass.

<!-- hint -->
Declare a scalar `${SHOP}`, a list `@{PRODUCTS}`, and a dictionary `&{PRICES}` in
the `*** Variables ***` section.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Read them in a test: `Should Be Equal    ${SHOP}    RF Demo Shop`,
`Length Should Be    ${PRODUCTS}    3`, and dictionary access
`${PRICES}[backpack]`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Create one more variable inline with `VAR    ${note}    checked` inside a test.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Variables ***
${SHOP}        RF Demo Shop
@{PRODUCTS}    backpack    lamp    mug
&{PRICES}      backpack=79    lamp=34    mug=19

*** Test Cases ***
Variables Are Defined
    Should Be Equal    ${SHOP}    RF Demo Shop
    Length Should Be    ${PRODUCTS}    3
    Should Be Equal    ${PRICES}[backpack]    79

Var Creates Inline
    VAR    ${note}    checked
    Should Be Equal    ${note}    checked
```
<!-- /solution -->

Run the suite:
